headline: BOS @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 4.46 at COL 3.81, with a projected total of 8.27. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: BOS moved -0.62 runs while COL moved -0.37, changing the projected margin by -0.25 runs. The projected total fell -0.99, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +20.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Sonny Gray has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for TJ Rumfield, Jake McCarthy, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Carlos Narváez, Andruw Monasterio because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
